What: land DesignReview, DesignReviewGraphics and ResponseBasisGraphics (and their tests) from branch surface/warm-update-20260921 onto main. PLS Neuro pins 7c3ff0a on that branch; main is d727969c and lacks these files.

Evidence bundle (durable, not in Git): /Users/bbuchsbaum/code/scala/plsneuro-fixtures/model-studio-hillclimb-20261002 — start with README.md there (layout, reference-implementation line map, how to run the audits, verified numbers).
Reference implementation: /Users/bbuchsbaum/code/scala/plsneuro-fixtures/model-studio-hillclimb-20261002/out/m7b/index.html (single inline script; line numbers below refer to it). It is a design mock on synthetic data: use it as a behavioural specification and a source of fixtures, not as validated science.
Design spec and consumer plan (PLS Neuro, branch studio/model-authoring-hillclimb at d47c988, worktree /private/tmp/plsneuro-model-studio): docs/plans/2026-10-02-model-studio-spec.md (invariants I1–I13 in section 3), docs/plans/2026-10-02-model-studio-native-plan.md. Example studies for fixtures: STUDIES (line 424): block localizer (TR 2, N 180), mixed gambles (N 240; gain, loss, gain×loss), delayed match-to-sample (N 210; sample/delay/probe/errors phases; accuracy), stop signal (N 200; FIR 10×2 s; rt n/a for successful stops, ssd n/a for go), category × attention (N 240; 12 cells × canonical+temporal+dispersion; 24 motion). Runs use seeds 11 and 29; motion from motionSet (418); FD/censoring and confounds in regenMotion (499).
